name: Windsong
bio: Archetype: Preparation Skill, Burst Damage, Extra Action. ⌽ Gain [Measure] whenever an ally Crits or applies [Confusion], increasing Crit Rate and Crit DMG. ⌽ Skills generate [Eureka], S1 consumes [Eureka] to boost damage and convert excess Crit Rate to Crit DMG. ⌽ Skill 2 generates multiple precast skills to stack/store. ⌽ Ultimate converts S2 cards into S1, then immediately launches all of her in-hand incantations. ⌽ During Ult, no longer loses [Eureka] and excess [Eureka] gained is instead converted into [Measure]. ⌽ Does incredible damage with the new Tuning unlocked in Chapter 7.
